summary: Evidence-based analysis of 11 structural AI writing failures, built entirely from real verbatim quotes extracted from 9 competitor YouTube transcripts (Brofessor Stein, EverythingProfessor, Serious History, The Analyst). Each gap shows the real human line from the transcript alongside what AI would produce for the same content. Every example is grounded in actual competitor data, not hypothetical comparisons. Designed as a two-pass checklist: humanizer (surface) + DNA pass (structural).
